title: Grade 2 Science — Fri, May 29
description: Animals Around Us — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis — names, food, homes, body
subject: science

questions.question: Match: Lion → ___ | Rabbit → ___ | Bee → ___
questions.explanation: Lion → Den (cave/shelter), Rabbit → Burrow (underground tunnel), Bee → Hive (wax structure).

questions.question: Classify: Tiger, Cow, Bear. Which is the BEST classification?
questions.explanation: Tiger eats only meat (carnivore), Cow eats only plants (herbivore), Bear eats both (omnivore).

questions.question: Which body covering matches which animal: Feathers / Scales / Fur?
questions.explanation: Birds have feathers, fish have scales, dogs (mammals) have fur.

questions.question: A frog can live on BOTH land and water. Such animals are called ___.
questions.explanation: Frogs are amphibians — they can live on land and in water. Amphi means both (Greek).

questions.question: Which of these is the odd one out: Cow, Deer, Rabbit, Lion?
questions.explanation: Cow, Deer, and Rabbit are herbivores. Lion is a carnivore — it eats the others!

questions.question: A bird's beak shape tells us what it eats. A sharp, hooked beak belongs to a ___.
questions.explanation: Eagles and hawks have sharp, hooked beaks to tear meat. Different beak shapes = different diets.

questions.question: Which statement is FALSE?
options: Birds have feathers and lay eggs
questions.explanation: Cows are NOT carnivores — they are herbivores that eat grass and plants.

questions.question: A snake is a reptile. Which of these is also a reptile?
questions.explanation: Crocodiles and snakes are both reptiles — scaly, cold-blooded animals. Frogs are amphibians, eagles are birds, whales are mammals.

questions.question: Why do herbivores have flat teeth?
options: To grind and chew plant material
questions.explanation: Herbivores have flat, broad teeth for grinding plants. Carnivores have sharp teeth for tearing meat.

questions.question: A peacock is a bird with beautiful feathers. It is a ___ animal.
questions.explanation: Peacocks are wild birds. They live in forests but can sometimes be seen in parks. They are the national bird of India.

questions.question: Which animal can regrow its tail if it is broken off?
questions.explanation: Lizards can shed their tail (called autotomy) to escape predators, and regrow it over time.

questions.question: Migratory birds travel long distances every year. Why?
options: To find warmer weather and food
questions.explanation: Migratory birds travel to warmer places in winter to find food. They return when spring arrives.

questions.question: Which animal uses camouflage to hide from enemies?
questions.explanation: A chameleon changes its skin color to match its surroundings — this is called camouflage.

questions.question: Which of these animals is a mammal?
questions.explanation: Whales are mammals — they breathe air, are warm-blooded, and feed their young milk. They just live in water!

questions.question: Week summary: which sentence is MOST complete?
options: Animals can be wild or domestic, eat plants/meat/both, and have different homes and body parts suited to where they live
All animals eat the same food
Only pets are useful to humans
questions.explanation: The week's key learning: animals are diverse — categorized by diet (herbivore/carnivore/omnivore), habitat (homes), and body features (wings, scales, fur, fins).
